entry.content: best_sellers: description +Use for what sells best in a department right now. The rank is Amazon's, not a sales figure. deals: description +Use for items currently promoted in Amazon's deals feed. Not for one product's price (product_details); for a brand by name use search with brand= and today_deals=true. offers_stock: description, inputSchema +Use to compare sellers' current offers and see who holds the buy box, and, with check_inventory, how many units a buyer can add to the cart now. The stock number is not a sales estimate. Not for the listing's own details (product_details). +When Amazon will not return the offer list for an ASIN, the result carries source=product_page: the featured (buy-box) offer read from the product page, offers_on_amazon (how many offers Amazon says exist) and a note; other sellers' offers and stock are then not included. parameters: +An Amazon product URL (…/dp/ASIN) works too, in place of an ASIN; lower case is fine. A URL's domain sets the marketplace unless geo says otherwise. product_details: description, inputSchema +Use for one product's current listing. Not for several ASINs (product_details_batch), seller offers or stock (offers_stock), or review text (product_reviews). parameters: +An Amazon product URL (…/dp/ASIN) works too, in place of an ASIN; lower case is fine. A URL's domain sets the marketplace unless geo says otherwise. product_details_batch: description, inputSchema +Use to enrich a list of ASINs in one call; compare the ASINs in `results` with the ones you sent. +ASINs Amazon has no record for on that marketplace are listed in not_returned (billed, like a not-found product_details call; retrying will not help). parameters: +An Amazon product URL (…/dp/ASIN) works too, in place of an ASIN; lower case is fine. A URL's domain sets the marketplace unless geo says otherwise. product_reviews: description, inputSchema +Use for what customers say about one product. Not for its full review history or star-filtered reviews (not available), or for seller feedback (seller_reviews). parameters: +An Amazon product URL (…/dp/ASIN) works too, in place of an ASIN; lower case is fine. A URL's domain sets the marketplace unless geo says otherwise. search: description +Use to find products by keyword and filters. Rows are result snippets; for the authoritative record of one ASIN call product_details. seller_products: description +Use to list one seller's storefront. seller_profile_batch: description +Use to vet sellers: name, rating and feedback counts as Amazon displays them. seller_reviews: description +Use for a seller's customer feedback (service, shipping). Not for product reviews (product_reviews).

entry.content: compare_products: description, inputSchema +An edition with no price in the requested currency keeps cheapest_cost in the original currency, unconverted, with budget_fit unknown and the assumption key cheapest_cost_foreign_currency (value the edition id). Stale offers (past fresh_until) are not used for cheapest_cost. get_current_offers: description, inputSchema +An offer past fresh_until has presentation_state stale: its price is the last checked price (see checked_at) and it is not a basis for a lowest price, budget fit, cheapest cost or list_deals prices_from; expired offers are not returned. list_deals: description, inputSchema +stale offers excluded, resolve_purchase_request: description, inputSchema +search_complete=false with optimality_scope=best_found marks an answer cut at a limit, a free-text term that looks like a product name (Latin letters, digits or katakana) but matches no registered alias (unresolved_constraints no_alias_match), or no candidates (no_candidates). Free-text aliases match whole words only. With a budget, candidates are ordered by budget_fit first (confirmed, estimated_within, estimated_over, over, unknown) before the answer is cut to max_candidates; when in-budget candidates are still cut, limits_hit contains budget_fit_candidates_truncated. An edition with no pri search_products: description, inputSchema -license. +license, or by a free-text product name (q). +Optional q (up to 200 characters) is a product name as typed: any spelling, katakana, hiragana or romaji; shopping words such as セール, 最安, sale or upgrade are ignored. It is matched like the site's own search (exact, prefix, substring, several words, then similar spellings that begin like the query, carry the same numbers and, for several words, cover the last word); a product type or category word (reverb, リバーブ, コンプ, ヘッドフォン) answers with up to 20 products of that type. Typed filters narrow q before the cut to 20. At most 20 products, in parameters: +input.q input.q description: A product name as typed (1 to 200 characters): any spelling, katakana, hiragana or romaji. Shopping words (セール, 最安, sale, upgrade, full version and similar) are ignored, and a query of shopping words only matches nothing. entry.title: remote/io.github.simonplmak-cloud/vision-driven-design 2026-09-28T142243110927 -> 2026-09-30T152315326297: 15 changed (every tool)
entry.content: vdd_amend: description +Parameter relationships: description is the requirement change to cascade through the artifact chain; projectRoot must match the root used by earlier phases. vdd_clarify: description +Parameter relationships: feature must be the exact spec directory name created by vdd_specify. vdd_clone: description +Parameter relationships: description is the target domain and statement is the desired outcome (both optional); maxPages, timeoutMs, concurrency, crawl, and browser tune the crawl and refresh=true bypasses a cached dataset. vdd_detect_environment: description +Parameter relationships: availableTools and capabilities are aliases; omit both to get the per-phase requirements without a present/missing comparison. vdd_get_next_task: description +Parameter relationships: feature must match the spec directory; the returned taskId (TASK-###) is the argument to vdd_implement. vdd_implement: description +Parameter relationships: taskId comes from vdd_get_next_task (format TASK-###); projectRoot must match the root used by earlier phases. vdd_init: description +Parameter relationships: projectRoot defaults to "." and must be the same root every later phase resolves against. vdd_inspect: description +Parameter relationships: scope="feature" requires feature, while scope="project" (the default) ignores it; projectRoot must match the root used by earlier phases. Choose vdd_inspect for the traceability matrix or per-feature metrics; use vdd_validate for the gate report. vdd_plan: description +Parameter relationships: feature must match the value passed to vdd_specify and vdd_tasks. vdd_specify: description +Parameter relationships: feature names the vdd/specs/<feature>/ directory and must match the feature passed to vdd_clarify, vdd_plan, and vdd_tasks; actionItemId is the A-### id from tactics.md and is optional when authoring from a freeform description. vdd_strategize: description +Parameter relationships: availableTools and capabilities are aliases (pass one); the first call returns research-subagent dispatch specs and a second call carrying researchFindings synthesizes strategy.md. vdd_tactics: description +Parameter relationships: projectRoot must match the root used by vdd_init, vdd_vision, and vdd_strategize; requires vdd/strategy.md to exist. vdd_tasks: description +Parameter relationships: feature must match the value passed to vdd_plan. vdd_validate: description +Parameter relationships: feature narrows the check to one spec; artifactFiles maps artifact path to content for serverless runs and is omitted when resolving against a local projectRoot. Choose vdd_validate for the release-readiness gate report; use vdd_inspect for the traceability matrix or per-feature spec metrics. vdd_vision: description +Parameter relationships: statement must be freeform prose (1-3 paragraphs), not a title; projectRoot must match the root used by vdd_init.
